INTJ.label: Architect
INTJ.desc: Strategic, logical, and driven by your own original ideas. You are an innovative, independent thinker who enjoys speculation and creative problem-solving to achieve long-term improvements.

INTP.label: Logician
INTP.desc: Intellectual, logical, and reserved with a flexible, imaginative mind. You are an original thinker who loves exploring theories and abstract concepts to find creative solutions.

ENTJ.label: Commander
ENTJ.desc: Strategic, logical, and ambitious with a gift for organizing people. You are an effective organizer who drives long-range planning and gets things done with decisive confidence.

ENTP.label: Debater
ENTP.desc: Inventive, enthusiastic, and entrepreneurial with a strategic mind. You enjoy new ideas, challenges, and value inspiration, often seeing possibilities others miss.

INFJ.label: Advocate
INFJ.desc: Idealistic, organized, and insightful with deep compassion. You seek harmony and cooperation, valuing personal growth and meaningful connections with others.

INFP.label: Mediator
INFP.desc: Sensitive, creative, and perceptive with an idealistic heart. You value inner harmony and personal growth, focusing on dreams and possibilities that feel authentic.

ENFJ.label: Protagonist
ENFJ.desc: Caring, enthusiastic, and diplomatically organized. You are a skilled communicator who values connection with people and inspires others through genuine warmth.

ENFP.label: Campaigner
ENFP.desc: Enthusiastic, creative, and spontaneously optimistic. You value inspiration and enjoy starting new projects while seeing the potential in others around you.

ISTJ.label: Logistician
ISTJ.desc: Responsible, sincere, and realistically systematic. You are hardworking and trustworthy, valuing practical judgment and a methodical approach to getting things done.

ISFJ.label: Defender
ISFJ.desc: Warm, considerate, and responsibly thorough. You are a devoted caretaker who enjoys being helpful to others, approaching life with pragmatic gentleness.

ESTJ.label: Executive
ESTJ.desc: Efficient, outgoing, and systematically dependable. You like to run the show and get things done in an orderly fashion, bringing analytical leadership to every situation.

ESFJ.label: Consul
ESFJ.desc: Friendly, outgoing, and conscientiously organized. You seek to be helpful and please others, enjoying being active and productive in building community.

ISTP.label: Virtuoso
ISTP.desc: Action-oriented, logical, and spontaneously reserved. You enjoy adventure and are skilled at understanding how mechanical things work with cool, analytical precision.

ISFP.label: Adventurer
ISFP.desc: Gentle, sensitive, and flexibly realistic. You seek to create a personal environment that is both beautiful and practical, approaching life with quiet curiosity.

ESTP.label: Entrepreneur
ESTP.desc: Outgoing, realistic, and versatile with a spontaneous edge. You are a pragmatic problem solver and skillful negotiator who thrives on action and new challenges.

ESFP.label: Entertainer
ESFP.desc: Playful, enthusiastic, and tactfully flexible. You have strong common sense and enjoy helping people in tangible ways with your spontaneous, friendly energy.

D.label: Dominant
D.desc: You move fast, speak clearly, and push toward results. The formal DISC label is Dominance, but the useful idea is direct action. You challenge weak ideas, ask what needs to happen next, and prefer honest decisions over polite delay.

I.label: Influential
I.desc: You bring energy, stories, and connection into the room. The formal DISC label is Influence, but the useful idea is social momentum. You help people care, participate, and believe the next step is possible.

S.label: Steady
S.desc: You create calm, trust, and consistency for the people around you. The formal DISC label is Steadiness, but the useful idea is steady support. You listen well, reduce chaos, and help groups move without breaking trust.

C.label: Conscientious
C.desc: You slow down for accuracy, evidence, and clean standards. The formal DISC label is Conscientiousness, but the useful idea is careful judgment. You ask better questions, catch weak details, and protect quality before mistakes ship.

O.label: Openness
O.high: You are strongly curious and get energy from new ideas. You notice possibilities that other people miss. Use that imagination by turning one idea into something real, not just collecting more options.
O.medium: You can enjoy new ideas without needing constant novelty. You balance imagination with practical judgment. Use that range by trying fresh options, then keeping what actually works.
O.low: You trust clear facts, proven methods, and stable routines. Abstract ideas need to earn your attention by becoming useful. Use that grounded style to make plans realistic and repeatable.

C.label: Structure / Follow-through
C.high: You are strongest when goals, plans, and standards are clear. People can rely on you to finish what you start. Use that follow-through, but do not let perfect planning delay a good first step.
C.medium: You can use structure without becoming trapped by it. You meet responsibilities while still adapting when life changes. Use simple systems that help you move, not complicated ones that slow you down.
C.low: You work best with freedom, flexibility, and room to adjust. Strict plans can feel like a cage. Use tiny deadlines and visible reminders so your ideas still become real work.

E.label: Extraversion
E.high: People and activity tend to charge you up. You think well out loud and often gain momentum through conversation. Use that energy by getting feedback early instead of waiting until everything is perfect.
E.medium: You can move between group energy and quiet focus. Some days need people; other days need space. Use that flexibility by choosing the setting that fits the task, not your habit.
E.low: Quiet time helps you recover and think clearly. You may still perform well socially, but too much noise drains your battery. Use solo preparation first, then share your thinking when it is ready.

A.label: Agreeableness
A.high: You naturally notice people’s needs and care about trust. Others may feel safe around you because you listen and cooperate. Use that warmth while still saying no when a boundary matters.
A.medium: You can be kind without losing your backbone. You prefer cooperation, but you can disagree when the situation calls for it. Use that balance to protect both the relationship and the truth.
A.low: You are direct, skeptical, and comfortable pushing back. You may spot weak logic faster than softer personalities do. Use that edge with clean respect so people hear the point instead of only feeling the impact.

N.label: Stress Reactivity
N.high: Your stress signal is loud and fast. That can feel heavy, but it also helps you notice risks early. Use it by naming the concern, choosing one next step, and building recovery time into the plan.
N.medium: Stress affects you, but it does not usually take over. You can feel pressure and still think clearly. Use that balance by checking your stress level before it quietly shapes the decision.
N.low: You tend to stay calm when pressure rises. That steadiness can help others feel safer. Use it well by adding early warning checks, because calm can sometimes hide problems until they are bigger.
